claims.claim: The TPLF said it temporarily withdrew from Mekelle because of risks to civilians as fighting with the national army moved toward the city.
claims.episode_span: The Tigray People's Liberation Front says it has temporarily withdrawn from Mekelle
claims.source_title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
claims.supporting_quote: Rebel forces in Ethiopia's northern Tigray region have said they have temporarily withdrawn from the regional capital, Mekelle, as fighting with the national army moves towards the city.

claims.claim: Two Mekelle residents told the BBC that pro-government forces control the city and TPLF fighters have left.
claims.episode_span: Two residents told the BBC that pro-government forces now control the city
claims.source_title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
claims.supporting_quote: Two residents in Mekelle told the BBC that pro-government forces now control the city and TPLF fighters have abandoned it.

claims.claim: The presidents of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan met on Sunday in El-Alamein and called for sovereignty and peaceful resolution of disputes.
claims.episode_span: The presidents of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan met in El-Alamein
claims.source_title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
claims.supporting_quote: The presidents of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan - which all have strained relations with Ethiopia - met on Sunday in the Egyptian coastal city of El-Alamein.

claims.claim: Ethiopia accuses Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan of supporting the Tigray rebels, which they deny.
claims.episode_span: Ethiopia accuses Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan of supporting the Tigray rebels, which they deny.
claims.source_title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
claims.supporting_quote: Ethiopia accuses Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan of supporting the Tigray rebels, which they deny.

claims.claim: The AU mediator estimated some 600,000 people died in the Tigray civil war that ended with the 2022 Pretoria Agreement.
claims.episode_span: the African Union's mediator estimated some 600,000 people died
claims.source_title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
claims.supporting_quote: The civil war was one of the most deadly conflicts this century - the AU's mediator estimated some 600,000 people died as the fighting drove the region to the precipice of famine.

claims.claim: WFP said one driver was killed Saturday when an airstrike hit two marked aid trucks between Dilling and Kadugli.
claims.episode_span: one driver was killed on Saturday when an airstrike hit two contracted trucks
claims.source_title: Strike on WFP Aid Trucks in Sudan Kills One
claims.supporting_quote: The WFP trucks were travelling on Saturday between the two cities of Dilling and Kadugli when they came under attack, despite being “clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles,” WFP said, according to AFP.

claims.claim: UN figures say army and RSF drones killed more than 1,100 people in the first half of the year, and aid workers estimate more than 200,000 killed and more than 11 million displaced since April 2023.
claims.episode_span: drones used by the army and the Rapid Support Forces killed more than 1,100 people
claims.source_title: Strike on WFP Aid Trucks in Sudan Kills One
claims.supporting_quote: Both the army and the RSF have increasingly deployed drones in recent months, with the high-tech weapons killing more than 1,100 people in the first half of the year alone, according to UN figures.

claims.claim: Security sources said Nigerian Army, DSS and Amotekun forces killed ISWAP leader Abdussalam Ohida, also known as Anwar, in Owo forest, Ondo State.
claims.episode_span: killed Islamic State West Africa Province leader Abdussamad Ohida, also known as Anwar
claims.source_title: Joint Army, DSS, Amotekun operation kills ISWAP leader in Ondo
claims.supporting_quote: An intelligence-led operation by a combined team of Nigerian Army troops, Department of State Services (DSS) personnel and Western Nigeria Security Network, also known as Amotekun, has killed a senior leader of the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP), Abdussamad Ohida.

claims.claim: A security source said Ohida planned civilian attacks during Yuletide and disruption of the 2027 elections, and that UK partners supported the operation.
claims.episode_span: planning attacks on civilians during the coming Yuletide and a disruption of the 2027 general elections
claims.source_title: Joint Army, DSS, Amotekun operation kills ISWAP leader in Ondo
claims.supporting_quote: “The plan was to attack civilians during the festive period and ultimately disrupt the 2027 general elections. This intelligence was corroborated by intelligence partners from the United Kingdom, who supported the elimination operation,” one of the sources said.

claims.claim: Yemeni government-aligned forces spokesman Majid Abdullah Al-Nuzaili said 1,122 attacks killed about 1,747 Houthi fighters and destroyed or disabled 364 vehicles.
claims.episode_span: carried out 1,122 attacks on Houthi targets
claims.source_title: Yemeni government forces claim over 1,120 attacks against Houthi positions
claims.supporting_quote: The spokesperson for Yemen’s government-aligned forces said that 1,122 attacks were carried out against Houthi targets, claiming that around 1,747 of the group's fighters were killed.

claims.claim: Lagos State has stopped admitting new diesel buses into its regulated fleet and directed operators toward CNG or electric vehicles.
claims.episode_span: stopped admitting new diesel-powered buses into its regulated public transport system
claims.source_title: Nigeria: Lagos Bars New Diesel Buses From Regulated Fleet, Mandates Cng, Electric Vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: The Lagos State Government has stopped admitting new diesel-powered buses into its regulated public transport system, directing operators to deploy compressed natural gas (CNG) or electric vehicles as it begins gradually replacing its diesel fleet.

claims.claim: Johannesburg delayed release of records on 4.07 billion rand in alleged financial misconduct until after the 4 November elections.
claims.episode_span: pushed release of records on 4.07 billion rand in alleged financial misconduct past the 4 November elections
claims.source_title: MUNICIPAL DYSFUNCTION: Joburg stalls release of R4.07bn misconduct files until after elections
claims.supporting_quote: The City of Johannesburg has pushed the release of records detailing R4.07bn in alleged financial misconduct beyond the 4 November elections, after an admitted nine-day administrative delay and an extension calculated in ‘court days’.

claims.claim: Israeli national flags were lowered to half-mast for the official memorial date of 7 October, with state ceremonies Monday and civil events and protests Wednesday.
claims.episode_span: National flags were lowered to half-mast as Monday, the official Israeli memorial date
claims.source_title: State ceremonies and anti-government protests: Israel marks three years since October 7
claims.supporting_quote: National flags were lowered to half-mast as Monday marks the official Israeli memorial date for October 7.

claims.source_title: Is Britain fueling the war in Yemen?
claims.supporting_quote: Fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis is at its worst since the 2022 truce, and nearly 130,000 Yemenis have been displaced in recent weeks.

claims.claim: MDGIF has approved an estimated 671 billion naira in FIDs, catalysed 1.6 trillion naira in investment, and holds 31 projects and 205 infrastructure assets.
claims.episode_span: approved an estimated 671 billion naira in those decisions, catalysed 1.6 trillion naira
claims.source_title: Nigeria’s gas turned into working assets
claims.supporting_quote: In under two years since its first Final Investment Decisions, MDGIF has approved an estimated ₦671 billion in FIDs, catalysed ₦1.6 trillion in total investments, and built a portfolio spanning 31 projects and 205 infrastructure assets.
